plumbing.name: 2021 IRC plumbing chapters for 1-2 family (NH list also adopts 2021 IPC with NH amendments)

elsewhere: The NH State Building Code (RSA 155-A) applies statewide on paper, but permits and inspections happen only where the town has set up enforcement; many small towns do not enforce. Frost depth and ground snow load are set town by town (frost commonly 48 in).
notes: Residential energy code is still the 2018 IECC. NH amends IRC R310.1 (egress), R313.2 (sprinklers), R302.13, Table R301.2(1) snow footnote and the electrical chapters; the numeric text of the NH egress change could not be retrieved (firemarshal and mm.nh.gov amendment PDFs returned errors), so no tracked-key value is reported. Sprinklers not required in 1-2 family by state code.
